desc: Offline design only. A reboot scrubs DRAM (evidence/2026-07-30-t6040-daily-driver-object-c1529d4c.md), so ramoops cannot hold a panic that ends in the watchdog reset. A kdump crash kernel loaded with kexec -p runs in place on panic, without iBoot, and can save pstore and /proc/vmcore. Tasks: check the 5019 .config for KEXEC_CORE, CRASH_DUMP, PROC_VMCORE, CRASH_RESERVE; size a crashkernel= reservation that avoids the ramoops region (0x10300000000 + 2 MiB) and m1n1's payload area (kernel 0x10008400000, FDT 0x10008600000, top-down allocations), checked against a live /proc/iomem (5020 evidence); decide whether the crash kernel may write p3 at all (no Flush, 5006: it would need its own clean controller shutdown) or only keeps the record in RAM for a following kexec. arm64 machine_kexec_prepare skips the stuck-CPU refusal for KEXEC_TYPE_CRASH (seen in the Gravity tree; confirm in the 5019 tree), so kexec -p may load on a maxcpus=1 kernel without nr_cpus=1 (the 5024 object). Otherwise it uses the kexec path that 5021 tests. Deliverable: a kbuild flag proposal and a bounded rig ticket draft; nothing built or booted.
